'''Azril''' is a serving girl at the inn [[Culain's Hound]] in [[Caemlyn]]. She has a plain face and is likely in her thirties. 
==Activities==
After [[Rand]] scares the girls that [[Verin]] brought from the Two Rivers to train in the Tower, Verin asks Azril to bring the girls tea with honey and brandy in it to calm them down.
